the CH-domain of Rng2 has an overall fold similar to other known CH domains, and the structure of Rng2 is similar to other actin-binding proteins that contain CH domains.
the structure of the Rng2 CH domain is similar to that of dystrophin, but that the structure of residues 154-190 is not.
the structure of the CH domain from Rng2 resembles that of the CH domain of utrophin, but that it also has a number of unique features.
